issue_context.title: Support optional content group visibility expressions
issue_context.body: See `8.11.2.2 Optional Content Membership Dictionaries` -> `VE` entry. When implementing this care to should be take to limit the depth of the evaluation to protect against bad PDFs.

review_comments:
Is there ever a risk, in a badly generated PDF document, that the `result` array is still *empty* after this call?
If that were to happen: is it correct to use the empty array here, or should we fallback to the "regular" parsing below?
It's probably safer to return the result only if its length > 0
